messages:
alex_m: Hey sec team — I need a brief admin-level window (approx 25–30m) to run targeted redaction tests against production-ingest logs for the GDPR audit. Will only touch 3 sample traces from service 'nlp-ingest'. Can I get JITA for role `log-redact-qa`? @ida_security

ida_security: What's the exact justification and the ticket? We need scoped role + start/end times + proof artifact. Also confirm no bulk exports.

alex_m: Ticket INT-4321. Purpose: validate regex-based redaction rules prior to audit; tests will run queries in LogSearch and call the `redact-sim` tool which only marks samples (no delete). Start window requested: today 16:10–16:40 UTC. I'll attach output and screenshots.

maria_dev: FYI the sample query I'll run:
```
logsearch query: service:nlp-ingest trace_id:(abc123 OR def456 OR ghi789) | redact-sim --pattern '([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})'
```
Role only needs `logs:read, logs:run-redact-sim`; no DB access.

sec-bot: Automated check: JITA policy requires approval from two security approvers OR one security + oncall. Please confirm approvers. Link: https://redwood/security/jita

sam_oncall: I can approve for oncall ground truth. Alex — please only run against the three trace_ids Maria listed and don't expand scope. I approve conditional on a 30m window and artifact upload to INT-4321.

ida_security: Approved JITA for `log-redact-qa` from 2026-03-17T16:10:00Z to 2026-03-17T16:40:00Z. Conditions: (1) use customer KMS key; (2) record commands in the ticket; (3) no exports. I'll lock elevation to only LogSearch namespace.

alex_m: Thanks all — starting at 16:10. Will post screenshots to INT-4321 when done.

alex_m: (16:36) Done — ran `redact-sim` against the 3 traces; attached screenshot + redaction log. No other queries ran.

ida_security: Received artifacts, filing note to audit. Closing access window. :white_check_mark:
